projectDescription: A modular school management platform that helps schools streamline compliance, safeguarding, development planning, risk management, staff appraisal, and more in one place.
keyFeatures: Compliance Audit — track statutory requirements across regulatory areas with colour-coded review dates and owner reminders
Safety Audit — 280 health and safety checks across 35 categories with configurable per-room frequency
Safeguarding Audit — Section 11 Children Act checks with area ownership and weekly email reminders
Risk Assessments — create, approve, and confirm risk assessments; staff are alerted on updates
Risk Register — record risks with likelihood/impact ratings and treatment strategies
Development Planning — multi-level school improvement plans with cascading actions, owners, and termly updates
Professional Development (Appraisal) — objective setting, interim review, self-review, and final review workflow
Professional Standards — teacher self-reflection against standards frameworks with evidence storage
School Calendars — publish iCal-integrated calendars with yearly rollover and staff subscriptions
Document Management — staff confirmation tracking for policies and key documents
Enrolment — online parent enrolment with DfE ATF export and consent gathering
Applications — sixth-form application management for internal and external students
Curriculum Publication — structured curriculum data published via JSON API for school websites
Self Evaluation Forms — Ofsted, SIAMS, Catholic, and Orthodox SEF frameworks with printable summaries
Site Room Checks — configurable periodic room-by-room health and safety audits
Website Utilities — staff contact forms and word-of-the-week content tools
AI Tools — experimental image generation and AI demonstration tools for school staff
Multi-school / MAT support — central management and cascading of plans, audits, and compliance items across groups of schools
publicApiSurface: GET /curriculum (JSON API) — returns published curriculum content by year and subject for school websites
iCal feed URLs — subscribe to school calendars from any calendar app
DfE ATF file export — import enrolment data into Management Information Systems
Email notification system — automated reminders for overdue compliance items, development actions, and appraisal milestones
Administrator portal — enable/disable modules, manage users, configure roles and permissions
Role-based access control — Administrator, Manager, Owner, Viewer roles per module
